meta.title: halkora — Make a promise. The ring keeps it.
meta.description: Build a shared goal with friends. One tap a day to check in and watch the ring fill. No confetti — just you, your crew, and a closing ring.

hero.sub: Set a shared goal, invite your crew. One tap a day to check in — the day's segment fills, and everyone sees it instantly.

manifesto.l4: Just you, your crew, and a filling ring.

how.title: Three steps. Then one tap a day.

s1.title: Start your ring
s1.copy: Pick a goal, write the daily action, set the duration. Takes 30 seconds.

s2.title: Invite your friends
s2.copy: A single invite link is enough. No account, no password, no email — just a name.

s3.title: One tap a day
s3.copy: Check in and the day's segment fills with ember. Your crew sees it instantly.

ringDemo.title: How does the ring fill?
ringDemo.copy: Keep scrolling. Every segment is a day; every day is a single tap.

m1.title: Day 1
m1.copy: You made a promise. The ring is set, everyone's in.

m2.title: Day 7
m2.copy: You've come this far. You won't stop now.

m3.title: Day 14
m3.copy: The ring closes. The stake settles.

features.title: No shaming. No judging. Just visibility.

stake.title: Put something on the line
stake.copy: The group places a small, friendly stake. The loser is clear — nobody gets shamed.

joker.title: Life happens
joker.copy: A missed day doesn't break the ring. Your joker day burns amber, and you move on.

social.title: Everyone, at a glance
social.copy: Every ring is open. See who showed up today and who's still pending.

wave.title: Wave at the quiet ones
wave.copy: No nagging, no lectures. A gentle “we're here” in one tap.

chat.title: A chat per ring
chat.copy: A simple day-by-day thread. No ads, no noise, no infinite scroll.
chat.b1: 30 pages down today, the book finally opened up 📖
chat.b2: I'll do mine tonight, before sleep 💪

story.rBody: Today's check-in is still on you.
story.l2: Phone in hand, eyelids getting heavy.
story.l3: Right as you're about to give in — a buzz.
story.closing: Three minutes later, the book is in your hand. One more segment fills.

widgets.title: Now on your home screen.
widgets.sub: See your ring without opening the app, check in with one tap. It lives on your home and lock screens now.
widgets.sCopy: One ring, one glance, one tap.
widgets.mCopy: Today's action and your crew's status, together.
widgets.lCopy: Your ring is there every time you pick up your phone — you can't scroll past it.
widgets.note: A completed widget goes quiet — no confetti; the filled ring is the reward.

done.title: 14 days. Together.
done.closing: Alone, it would've ended on day three. In the ring, it went all fourteen.

share.chip: This is what you share when it's done
share.title: Show your friends.
share.sub: Every finished ring becomes a shareable card — four looks, one moment.

quote.line: Yesterday didn't happen. You're here today.

cta.title: Are you in?
cta.sub: Starting your first ring takes 30 seconds.
cta.note: Free download · No accounts · No ads

soon.title: Coming soon to the App Store
soon.body: Halkora is going through its final checks. You'll be able to download it here the moment it ships.

footer.tagline: Make a promise. The ring keeps it.
